entities.name: MMM1
observations: The 448-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Debaryomyces hansenii MMM1/Mdm1 (UniProt Q6BH42; 100% identity and coverage; E-value 5.81e-303).
MMM1 is a single-pass type I endoplasmic-reticulum membrane protein with a lumenal N-terminal region (residues 1-74), transmembrane helix at residues 75-95, and cytoplasmic C-terminal region.
The query contains an MMM1 Pfam domain (PF10296.16) at residues 149-428; the homologous reference annotates an SMP-LTD domain at residues 164-419.

MMM1 is a component of the ERMES/MDM complex and contributes to ER-mitochondria tethering, nonvesicular lipid transfer, mitochondrial morphology, mtDNA nucleoid maintenance, and mitochondrial outer-membrane beta-barrel protein assembly.
The protein is reported as a homodimer and associates with MDM12, MDM10, and MDM34 in the ERMES/MDM complex.
Sequence-derived properties: length 448 aa, estimated molecular weight 50.2 kDa, theoretical pI 5.26, GRAVY -0.47, and predicted net charge at pH 7 of about -13.6.

entities.name: MDM12
observations: MDM12 is an ERMES/MDM complex partner of MMM1; the annotated MMM1-MDM12 subcomplex forms a continuous hydrophobic tunnel for phospholipid trafficking.
The query analysis supports association with MDM12 through the reviewed MMM1 reference annotation, not through a direct interaction assay on this sequence.

entities.name: ERMES complex
observations: The ERMES/MDM complex tethers the endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria and supports lipid transfer and mitochondrial organization.
MMM1 is a structural component of this complex.

entities.name: Mitochondrial morphology maintenance
observations: MMM1 contributes to establishing and maintaining mitochondrial structure and mitochondrial DNA nucleoids in fungi.
